findings.title: Coach availability for weekend/evening-shift staff — confirmed working, no defect
findings.description: Tomás raised a concern about whether coach availability would work for a team that works weekends/evenings (wedding events). Priya reports her coordinators book sessions on off-days/mid-week and always find an available coach — there is no scheduling gap or complaint here. This is positive confirmation, not a product issue.
findings.quote: Not really. My coordinators book their sessions on their off-days, mid-week usually. There's always someone available when they look.
findings.severity_reason: No defect reported; customer confirms the current behavior meets her team's needs.
findings.match_note: Not a complaint or gap — customer explicitly says availability is not an issue for her team.

findings.title: Mobile app booking flow — positive feedback, no change requested
findings.description: Priya says the mobile app is what makes coaching adoption work for her mobile, desk-less workforce: coordinators book sessions from their phones during brief lulls at events. She states the app being mobile-first is essential and that a desktop-only product would have caused her to cancel. No defect or missing capability is described.
findings.quote: It did. Honestly the mobile app helped. They book from their phones during a lull at an event, which is the only free minute they get.
findings.severity_reason: Purely positive feedback about an existing capability; nothing to fix or build.
findings.match_note: No defect or feature gap raised; customer is praising current mobile app functionality, not requesting anything.

findings.title: General platform check-in — no specific issues reported by customer or team
findings.description: When asked directly if anything on the platform is annoying her or her team, Priya says she personally hasn't noticed anything this month and that no team members have complained, noting her team is normally vocal about complaints so their silence is meaningful. No concrete product behavior, location, or repro detail is given.
findings.quote: Honestly I'm too fried this month to have noticed anything. Nobody's complained to me, and my coordinators complain about everything, so silence is meaningful.
findings.severity_reason: No specific defect or request identified; statement is a general absence of complaints.
findings.match_note: Too vague to action — no specific behavior, screen, or repro is described, and no complaint is actually being raised.

findings.title: Multi-city expansion account structure — commercial/account question, not a product defect or feature gap
findings.description: Priya asks whether a planned second-city (Nashville) expansion would be run under the same BetterBark account or a separate one. Tomás answers it would stay the same account with additional seats and an optional location tag for separate reporting. This is a commercial/account-structure clarification, not a report of a product defect or an unmet product capability, and the expansion itself is still only a maybe for next year.
findings.quote: Would it be the same account, or a separate one for the new city?
findings.severity_reason: No product defect or capability gap; purely an account-structure question already answered on the call.
findings.match_note: Account/commercial structuring question, not a product bug or feature request — no engineering action possible.
